name: RaktDrishti Non-Invasive Anemia Risk Model
description: Multi-site optical colorimetric feature fusion model for anemia screening.
author: Omnikon 2026 BioTech Team

inputs.name: conjunctiva_features
inputs.description: Erythema Index, CIELAB L*, a*, b*, HCI, Red Ratio

inputs.name: nail_features
inputs.description: Capillary redness, Vascularity Index, L*, a*

inputs.name: palm_features
inputs.description: Palmar pallor index, Erythema, L*, a*

inputs.name: quality_scores
inputs.description: Image quality assessment scores for each site

outputs.name: risk_score
outputs.description: Continuous anemia risk score between 0.0 and 1.0

clinical_safety_notice: Screening aid only. Does not replace clinical laboratory hematology analyzer.
